How ENGENE Made Connection the Group's Identity

The fandom name turned I-LAND's participatory origins into an official identity built around shared growth and support.

Introduction

The announcement of ENGENE as ENHYPEN’s official fandom name did more than give fans a shared label. It extended the participatory spirit of I-LAND into the group’s official identity by recognising that supporters had helped shape ENHYPEN before debut and would continue to play a visible role afterwards. Rather than presenting fans as passive consumers, BELIFT LAB invited name submissions from the global community, involved the members in selecting the final result, and built the meaning of the name around mutual growth. In this way, the transition from I-LAND to ENGENE preserved the idea that the relationship between ENHYPEN and its audience was something created together rather than simply announced from above.[Weverse]weverse.ioNotice] ENHYPEN Fan Club Naming Event InformationWeverse[Notice] ENHYPEN Fan Club Naming Event Information…

The Two Meanings Behind ENGENE

The official explanation of ENGENE deliberately combines two complementary ideas that reflect the group’s identity.

First, “engine” represents the fans as the driving force behind ENHYPEN’s continued progress. The message is straightforward: the members move forward because of the encouragement, energy and support they receive from their audience.

Second, “gene” expresses the idea that ENHYPEN and their fans share the same DNA, symbolising a relationship built on connection, discovery, development and growth together. This interpretation closely mirrors the meaning behind the group’s own name, ENHYPEN, which centres on connection and bringing separate elements together. Rather than positioning artists and fans as separate groups, the official definition describes them as partners in a shared journey.[Weverse]weverse.ioNOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open InformationWeverse[NOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open Information…

This dual meaning also subtly continued the narrative established during I-LAND. Viewers had watched the trainees develop week by week, and the fandom name reframed that process as an ongoing relationship rather than something that ended with the finale.

How Fan Submissions Shaped the Naming Process

One of the clearest ways the ENGENE name extended I-LAND’s participatory model was through its selection process.

Following ENHYPEN’s formation, BELIFT LAB opened a public naming event on Weverse, inviting fans worldwide to submit ideas for the official fan club name together with explanations of their meanings. The announcement explained that ENHYPEN’s members would personally review the submissions and choose the official name. The selected fan would receive a commemorative group Polaroid, while duplicate entries would be awarded to the earliest submission, encouraging original participation.[Weverse]weverse.ioNotice] ENHYPEN Fan Club Naming Event InformationWeverse[Notice] ENHYPEN Fan Club Naming Event Information…

When the final announcement was made, BELIFT LAB explicitly thanked fans for their “valuable contributions” and stated that the members had spent considerable time discussing the submitted ideas before reaching a decision. The company also confirmed that ENGENE itself originated from the fan submission process rather than being imposed entirely by management.[Weverse]weverse.ioNOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open InformationWeverse[NOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open Information…

This mattered because it echoed the collaborative atmosphere of I-LAND. Although fans no longer voted on eliminations, they were still invited to influence a lasting part of ENHYPEN’s identity.

From Pre-Debut Viewers to Official Membership

The introduction of ENGENE also provided continuity for people who had followed ENHYPEN before their debut.

During I-LAND, supporters invested time by watching performances, discussing contestants and participating in global voting. Once the programme ended, that temporary community needed a new identity. Announcing the official fandom name only weeks after the finale created a clear transition from television audience to recognised fan community.

BELIFT LAB reinforced this continuity by pairing the fandom-name announcement with the launch of ENGENE Membership, the group’s official fan club. Membership formalised the relationship through benefits and exclusive experiences while retaining the language of travelling forward together. Instead of suggesting that participation ended after debut, the company framed membership as the next stage of the shared journey.[Weverse]weverse.ioNOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open InformationWeverse[NOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open Information…

For many early supporters, becoming ENGENE represented an evolution of the role they had already played rather than the beginning of an entirely new relationship.

Why the Naming Strategy Worked

The ENGENE announcement illustrates how the participation model of I-LAND evolved from a television format into a long-term fandom identity.

Several implementation choices reinforced this continuity:

  • Open submissions acknowledged that fans had ideas worth contributing rather than simply receiving official branding.
  • Member involvement in the selection maintained the collaborative relationship established during the survival programme.
  • A symbolic meaning centred on mutual growth connected directly with ENHYPEN’s broader identity of connection and progress.
  • Immediate integration with official membership transformed emotional investment into an organised global community.[Weverse]weverse.ioNotice] ENHYPEN Fan Club Naming Event InformationWeverse[Notice] ENHYPEN Fan Club Naming Event Information…

Together, these decisions ensured that participation did not end when I-LAND concluded. Instead, it became institutionalised as part of ENHYPEN’s official fan culture.

Lasting Significance for ENHYPEN’s Identity

Many K-pop fandom names symbolise support or affection, but ENGENE stands out because its origin reflects the circumstances of ENHYPEN’s formation. The name does not simply describe fans; it acknowledges that the group’s earliest supporters were already participants in its story.

That distinction continues to shape how ENHYPEN presents its relationship with fans. Official communications repeatedly describe ENGENE as both the group’s driving force and a community that grows alongside the members, reinforcing the same themes first introduced through the fan naming event. The result is a fandom identity that extends I-LAND’s collaborative spirit into ENHYPEN’s long-term narrative, turning a pre-debut audience into an officially recognised partner in the group’s continuing development.[Weverse]weverse.ioNOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open InformationWeverse[NOTICE] ENHYPEN Official Fan Club Name & ENGENE MEMBERSHIP Open Information…
